title: Placement with the Collection Agency, Credit Reporting and Small-Balance Write-Off (Patient Invoices & Statements)
content:
An unpaid Patient Invoices & Statements invoice is placed with the collection agency only when every condition below holds; the credit reporting and write-off rules that follow apply to the same invoices.

## Clauses

**1. Conditions for placement.** An unpaid invoice may be placed in collections only when the billing class allows placement, the final notice has been issued, the class's days after the final notice have passed since it, and the balance is at least the class's smallest balance placed.

**2. Waiting period from the first statement.** An invoice may be placed with a collection agency only on or after the billing class's minimum calendar days after the first statement date. That minimum is 120 calendar days on the classes that allow placement; on the classes that do not allow placement it is 0, meaning the invoice is never placed. The waiting period counts calendar days with the first statement date as day 0, and placement on the last day of the period is allowed. The first statement date is the one recorded on that same invoice.

**3. Credit reporting.** The agency may report a placed balance to credit bureaus only when the billing class allows credit reporting, the balance is at least the class's smallest reportable balance, and the class's days before credit reporting have passed since placement.

**4. Agency fee.** The agency's fee is never added to the patient's balance.

**5. Small balances.** A balance below the billing class's small-balance write-off threshold still unpaid after the final notice is written off instead of placed.

## Placement conditions in combination

| Class allows placement | Final notice issued | Days after the final notice passed | Balance at least the smallest balance placed | Waiting period from the first statement date reached | May be placed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No | any | any | any | any | No |
| Yes | No | any | any | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | any | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | No | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | No |

## Counting the waiting period (hypothetical dates, 120-day period)

| Date | Day of the count | Placement |
|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2026 (first statement date) | day 0 | not allowed |
| 9 May 2026 | day 119 | not allowed |
| 10 May 2026 | day 120, the last day of the period | allowed |
| 11 May 2026 | day 121 | allowed |

## Credit reporting in combination

| Class allows reporting | Placed balance at least the smallest reportable balance | Days before credit reporting passed since placement | Agency may report |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| No | any | any | No |
| Yes | No | any | No |
| Yes | Yes | No | No |
